Silvia and her mother (via Facetime) take the leftovers and completely reinvent them as a delicious homemade Spaghetti Frittata.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Get tangled in today's episode with Kirsten's delicious Babka Knots. The Chocolate Queen also gives her best recipes for entertaining with Chocolate Truffle Cups and a Hazelnut Tart.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: It’s a party in a glass! Our dessert makers must create a fabulous Ice-Cream Sundae that pushes the culinary boundaries of this simple fare.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: It's truffle season and everyone in the Périgord Noir region of France has gone truffle crazy. Host Sarah Sharratt is excited to get her hands on one of these much prized fungi to see what the fuss is all about. Sarah prepares a truffle packed dinner featuring truffled brie, champagne risotto with black truffles, barbecued beef with a traditional truffle sauce and chocolate truffles.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie cooks up his Thai-style Crispy Sea Bass, a super-quick, flavor-packed fish supper. Followed by baked garlicky mushrooms, a sensational veggie tray bake that’s ridiculously tasty. Then Jamie’s Sweet Chicken Surprise.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Singaporean cuisine is widely influenced by several ethnic groups that make up the population. MasterChef winner Sashi Cheliah, raised in Singapore, shares his ‘Quick & easy Briyani’ which has a distinct Indian flair. Next is the famous ‘Fish Head Curry’, which has mixed Indian and Chinese influences. Finaly, Diana cooks one of her favourite ‘Hokkien Mee’, a simple noodle dish created using a homemade prawn stock.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana explores Korean food. Charlie Carrington (chef and owner of Atlas Dining) shows Diana how to ferment your own kimchi at home before cooking up a ‘Beef Bulgogi’, a dish of delicious marinated beef cooked at high heat and topped with quintessential Korean condiments. Diana decides to make a vegetarian version of ‘Bibimbap’.
